ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
